robot_messages.main: I recommend Water Lilies. I recommend this painting because it is immediately beautiful. Monet was not trying to paint the pond exactly as it looked — he was capturing the feeling of light and color on the water at a specific moment. You'll find it to the left of "Sunflower Field with Cypresses".
robot_messages.follow_up: Did you enjoy "Water Lilies"? Would you like to know more or see another one?
